description: Search the ChangeGamer corpus by keyword. Every word must match the title, tags, category, description or (as a last resort) the body; results rank title > tags > category > description > body, the same order as the site search. Returns metadata plus HTML/Markdown/JSON URLs (no body content). Use this to find resources before fetching them with get_resource.
